dataList.flavor: An A+ class Workshop weapon, у которого есть remained a constant companion of its wielder, the Fixer при the Crack of Dawn, since his first days as a Fixer through the Smoke War и its fallout. Every contract successfully carried out на the Fixer added to Stigma Workshop's fame, и as a show of gratitude, they repeatedly upgraded и expanded the weapon's capabilities. Just as the Fixer's seasoned renown was built up over time, this blade, too, was forged, remade, и sharpened на the years. Morgenfeuer, один раз regarded as an S-class weapon, inevitably lost its fervor и edge in the twilight years of the Fixer при the Crack of Dawn as he withdrew from the front lines of the Fixer business in favor of teaching the next generation.

dataList.flavor:
The appeal of a weapon shaped like a suitcase или a musical instrument case is clear enough.

First, the user may blend в the cover of daily life without raising alarm. Though arms of this sort are unwieldy и complicated to make use of in battle, that perceived shortcoming makes them less likely to be recognized as tools of killing.

Secondly, weapons fashioned в the form of a case afford storage capacity. Container-shaped arms, for example, are actively used на the Fixers of the Devyat' Association.

Such convenience, however, не automatically win favors from those who elect Workshop gear as their weapon of choice. The common opinion is that anyone who invests so much time in mastering this sort of weaponry would be better served на training with something else—in fact, the user would often hear snide remarks from other combatants, ranging from "Fixers these days" to "showy и pretentious."

But should one let this reputation for impracticality drop one's guard когда facing an opponent armed with such a finicky piece of equipment, especially если they happen to be a high-ranking Fixer или a Syndicate officer, one will find that the laughable "containers" или "cases" carry quite a different weight—a weight grave enough for any Workshop worth its name to call them "coffins." And coffins, as a matter of fact, have a way of inviting butterflies.

dataList.flavor:
There is only so much piercing power to be gained from sharpening a spearhead. Spears forged from Patented alloys или rare materials recovered from the Ruins may offer greater results, but their price can rival several years' worth of an ordinary Fixer Office's budget. A far more economical approach is to harness the surrounding currents of wind и coil them around the weapon, granting it formidable piercing power при a fraction of the cost. The technique is well-established, with many Workshops offering their own implementations.

Офис Глиномесов's spears are the handiwork of one such Workshop. Combined with the Office's distinctive spearwork, which makes masterful use of twisting и rotational movements, these weapons have run countless foes through.
